data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Prescriptions originating from Guernsey and dispensed in England require accurate monitoring to ensure compliance with reimbursement arrangements and financial governance. The Guernsey Reports in ePACT2 provide authorised users with detailed insights into prescribing activity and associated costs for items prescribed in Guernsey but processed by NHS Prescription Services.

These reports include data such as item counts, Net Ingredient Cost (NIC), and dispensing contractor details, enabling commissioners and finance teams to validate claims and reconcile payments. Users can filter by time period and therapeutic category, supporting bespoke analysis and trend monitoring. The reports also assist in identifying prescribing patterns that may require further review, ensuring that cross-border prescribing aligns with agreed protocols.

The aim of the Guernsey Reports is to promote transparency and accountability in prescribing and reimbursement for prescriptions originating outside England. They help organisations assess whether prescribing activity is clinically appropriate and financially accurate, reducing unwarranted variation and supporting medicines optimisation. While these reports provide essential financial and operational data, they should be used alongside other dashboards to inform strategic decisions. Their intention is to support compliance with NHS payment rules, strengthen governance, and maintain equitable resource allocation across the health system.
